description: This file defines functions related to default data types in the c10 namespace, including getter and setter functions for default ScalarType and TypeMeta data types.

methods.name: set_default_dtype
methods.description: Sets the default data type using a TypeMeta object.

methods.name: get_default_dtype
methods.description: Returns the current default data type as a TypeMeta object.

methods.name: get_default_dtype_as_scalartype
methods.description: Returns the default data type as a ScalarType enumeration.

methods.name: get_default_complex_dtype
methods.description: Returns the default complex data type as a TypeMeta object.
